reason: Hypothesis A more precisely addresses the research question by specifying a controlled comparison between the quinary and Mn-free subsets, clearly linking Mn-induced magnetic frustration to suppression of the fcc-to-hcp transformation and nanotwinning, and providing a well-defined falsification experiment. Hypothesis B is similar but less specific in its predictions and boundary conditions, and it introduces an unsupported quantitative claim (10–20% reduction in critical strain) without cited evidence.
